backend/main.mo: Motoko actor implementing the QuickRepair backend with user registration/profile management, feedback submission and rating, access control via role-based permissions, and admin operations for managing users and feedback.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing two confirmed high-confidence features: removing an anchor/SVG icon element and removing the 'Call Now' button from the Header component in frontend/src/components/Header.tsx.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and recent changes, serving as a reference index for the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom property tokens for light and dark themes, including colors for background, foreground, card, sidebar, and chart elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickRepair app including Google site verification, AdSense meta tags, preconnect hints for ICP endpoints, and a LocalBusiness JSON-LD schema with service offerings and area coverage.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React app component that sets up React Query, lazy-loads below-fold sections, and routes between the main site, admin, booking, booking history, mechanic registration, and terms pages based on the current pathname.
frontend/src/components/AboutSection.tsx: Renders the 'About Us' section with a text description of QuickRepair and a 2x2 grid of highlight cards (response time, verified pros, pricing, coverage) using fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/AdminPage.tsx: Password-protected admin dashboard with tabs for managing users, feedback, services (CRUD), and mechanic registrations, using React Query hooks for all data operations.
frontend/src/components/BookingFormSecti: Booking form section that requires Internet Identity authentication; on submission it posts form data to FormSubmit and shows a success overlay with a sound effect.
frontend/src/components/BookingSuccessOv: Full-screen portal overlay that displays an animated SVG checkmark and 'Booking Confirmed' message, auto-dismissing after 2.8 seconds.
frontend/src/components/ContactSection.t: Displays contact information (phone, email, working hours) and a list of six service areas in a two-column card layout with fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/FAQSection.tsx: Accordion-style FAQ section with nine questions about the service; each item expands/collapses with a smooth max-height transition and highlights the active question in gold.
Displays a feedback/reviews section with sample and live reviews fetched from the backend, star ratings, and a form to submit new feedback using React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/FloatingCallButt: Renders a fixed floating call button linking to a phone number with a gradient style and 'Call Now' label.
frontend/src/components/FloatingWhatsApp: Renders a fixed floating WhatsApp button with a pulse animation that opens a pre-filled WhatsApp chat link.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with logo, navigation links, a booking button, copyright notice, and a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky header with logo, navigation drawer, Internet Identity login/logout, user profile dropdown, and a profile creation modal triggered when no profile exists.
frontend/src/components/HeroSection.tsx: Full-screen hero section with animated fade-in content, a background image, tagline, and CTA buttons for booking and calling.
frontend/src/components/HowItWorksSectio: Displays a three-step 'How It Works' process (Book, Arrive, Solved) with icons, connector lines, and fade-in animation.
frontend/src/components/NavigationDrawer: A mobile slide-in navigation drawer that highlights the active section via scroll spy, shows nav links, and conditionally renders Booking History for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/Overlay.tsx: A full-screen semi-transparent backdrop overlay component used to dim content behind the mobile navigation drawer.
frontend/src/components/ProfileModal.tsx: A modal form for collecting and submitting a user's name, phone number, and service area to register their profile via the useRegisterUser mutation.
frontend/src/components/ServiceCard.tsx: Displays a single repair service with its icon, description, starting price, and a Book Online button that navigates to the booking page.
Renders a grid of service cards fetched from the backend, falling back to hardcoded services if none are available, with a loading spinner during fetch.
frontend/src/components/TrustStatsBar.ts: A horizontal stats bar displaying key trust metrics (happy customers, response time, star rating) with fade-in animation on scroll.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, using an authenticated identity when available and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFadeIn.ts: A custom hook that uses IntersectionObserver to set a visibility flag when the referenced element scrolls into view, enabling fade-in animations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via DFINITY's AuthClient, exposed through a React context and hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including feedback CRUD, user profile management, admin checks, service listings, bookings, and mechanic registrations. Uses a delayed-ready pattern for feedback queries to improve initial page paint performance.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollSpy.ts: Custom hook that tracks which section is currently in view by comparing scroll position against section element offsets, returning the active section ID.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter/Poppins fonts and Tailwind, defining CSS custom properties for the dark theme, and declaring animations for fade-in sections, service card hovers, and a GPay-style booking success overlay.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/BookingHistoryPage.ts: Page that displays a logged-in user's past bookings sorted newest-first, showing date, time, service ID, address, and phone for each booking, with login prompts for unauthenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/BookingPage.tsx: Booking form page that requires Internet Identity authentication, submits form data via FormSubmit fetch, and shows a GPay-style success overlay with sound on successful submission.
frontend/src/pages/MechanicRegistrationP: Mechanic registration form page with client-side validation that submits data via the useSubmitMechanicRegistration mutation and displays a portal-rendered GPay-style success overlay on completion.
frontend/src/pages/TermsPage.tsx: Renders the Terms and Policies page for QuickRepair, displaying sections covering response time, service guarantee, pricing, service area, and customer feedback in a dark-themed layout.
frontend/src/utils/playSuccessSound.ts: Provides a utility function that plays a Google Pay-style ascending C-E-G major chord arpeggio using the Web Audio API, silently failing if unsupported.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module for extracting, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom fonts, brand/surface color tokens, box shadows, border radii, and keyframe animations for the frontend, with typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Tracks the project's current state including architectural notes, known issues, completed features, and pending tasks such as adding an Internet Identity login button to the Admin Dashboard and removing header elements.
